description: This Java class 'TrustManagerFactoryFactory' creates and manages TrustManagerFactory instances from various sources, including default CAs and custom certificates, with support for revocation checking.

classes.name: TrustManagerFactoryFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating TrustManagerFactory instances from various certificate sources, with support for revocation checking and insecure trust managers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new TrustManagerFactoryFactory with either DittoHeaders or ExceptionMapper.

methods.name: newTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Creates a TrustManagerFactory with optional trusted certificates and revocation check.

methods.name: createTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Internal method to initialize TrustManagerFactory with custom or default CA certificates and revocation settings.

methods.name: loadDefaultCAKeystore
methods.description: Loads the default Java CA keystore from the system's security directory.
